question: Does fixed depth1 tone continuation improve chronological-holdout airport temperature forecasts over native median and seasonal24?

design.question: Does fixed depth1 tone continuation improve chronological-holdout airport temperature forecasts over native median and seasonal24?
design.cohort: Same fixed8 airports and October08/15/22/29 UTC origins; two incomplete JFK futures excluded prospectively before native inference.
design.primary: hybrid versus native, separately for each model
design.secondary: native and hybrid versus seasonal24; tones_zero versus hybrid descriptive diagnostic
design.tones_zero: Predeclared analytic control: accepted oscillatory tones only with zero residual, including zero DC; if abstained predicts zero. Diagnostic, not a competitive temperature baseline.
design.rule: Unmodified selective_tree.decompose(depth=1), stability=.65 energy=.15 prominence=8, frequency2..48/128. No training, new tuning, veto, refit, depth selection or forecast selection.
design.numeric: Decompose original float64 Celsius history; verify reconstruction rtol=atol=1e-12. Native inputs cast once to float32; singleton geometry. Native repeat and abstention gates are exact, never tolerance-based.
design.gates: All finite; every bank input predicted twice in separate batch1 calls (second pass reversed); exact repeat; additive reconstruction; exact abstention identity for all abstentions and a planted constant-history instrument. Deny all target/raw-data reads in worker.
design.loss: Per window: mean32 squared errors / original float64 population history variance (ddof0). No epsilon: fail if variance<=0. Then mean windows within each station, then equal mean8 stations.

uncertainty.resample: Same8 station indices with replacement shared across all methods/models; preserve all windows within station.
uncertainty.caution: Shared weather creates dependence across stations; intervals are descriptive, not calibrated population confidence or significance. No sign-test/population-mean claim.

design.hypothesis: Forecast grounding on chronologically unseen observations; geography, climate and temperature distribution can have been seen. Native outputs are medians, not means; squared-error findings do not identify training prior.
design.budget: <=300seconds/model including loading and gates; CPU1, RSS<=3GiB; cached offline weights. At most1 native worker in this track; explicit later slot2 grant required; no partial scoring.
design.budget_estimate: <=122 singleton calls/model (2*(30+30+1)); previous TF3968 calls plus gates560.7s, conservative estimate<90s/model including load. Hard300s supervisor bound.

interpretation.primary: Fixed depth1 hybrid increases equal-station mean normalized MSE versus native for both models in this pilot.
interpretation.uncertainty: Bolt descriptive gain interval entirely negative; TimesFM interval crosses zero. Neither is a calibrated population inference because stations share weather and n=8.
interpretation.native_vs_seasonal: Both native median models have lower observed equal-station mean normalized MSE than seasonal24.
interpretation.tone_only: Zero-residual diagnostic omits temperature DC and is not a competitive baseline; high loss does not isolate tone quality.
interpretation.scope: Observed October2026 observations postdate exact cached weight revisions. No unseen-location or unseen-distribution claim; MSE does not identify a median forecaster training prior.

controls: All finite; every bank input predicted twice in separate batch1 calls (second pass reversed); exact repeat; additive reconstruction; exact abstention identity for all abstentions and a planted constant-history instrument. Deny all target/raw-data reads in worker.
limitations: Shared weather creates dependence across stations; intervals are descriptive, not calibrated population confidence or significance. No sign-test/population-mean claim.

Forecast grounding on chronologically unseen observations; geography, climate and temperature distribution can have been seen. Native outputs are medians, not means; squared-error findings do not identify training prior.
Quality flags null means unflagged, not evidence that QC completed; archived data are not a real-time vintage.
evidence_class: behavioral chronological-observation holdout, descriptive8-station pilot with independent instrumentation audit
next_decision: Pilot complete. Review negative hybrid-versus-native result before any additional weather conditions, tuning, downloads or native compute. No expansion authorized; slot2 released for Carsonphase.
